## Core Competencies & Technology Stack
- **Native Android Engineering**: Kotlin, Jetpack Compose, Java, Coroutines & Flow, Hilt / Dagger DI, Room DB, Android SDK, Material 3, Foreground Services.
- **Cross-Platform Flutter**: Dart, Riverpod, BLoC State Management, Isar DB, iOS App Store deployment, Google Play Console release, Platform Channels.
- **Full-Stack Web Development**: React.js, Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, HTML5/CSS3, Server-Side Rendering (SSR), Progressive Web Apps (PWA).
- **Enterprise CRM & ERP Systems**: Role-Based Access Control (RBAC), Multi-Tenant Architectures, Executive Admin Dashboards, Automated Invoicing, Audit Logs, Requisition Approval Hierarchies, Inventory & Asset Management.
- **Backend & Cloud Systems**: RESTful APIs, FastAPI (Python), Node.js, .NET Core, WebSockets, PostgreSQL, SQLite, Firebase Firestore, Microsoft Azure, Docker Containers, GitLab CI/CD, GitHub Actions.
- **Software Architecture**: 3-Tier Clean Architecture, MVVM, Repository Pattern, Modular App Design, Unidirectional Data Flow, Offline-First Synchronization.
- **Applied AI & Automation**: LLM APIs (OpenAI, Gemini), RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) Architectures, Prompt Engineering, Dify Workflows, Langflow, n8n Automation.
